about_the_game:
You are being swarmed!

Send the hostile waves of worms back into the void by throwing them into walls, pulling them into rifts, disintegrating them with eldritch hexes...

Powerfully unique post-level superpowers!

Each and every varied level reward item choice adds a new mechanic to the game for explosive synergies and combos...

Auto-attack with swift manual dash!

Combine the convenience of homing auto-attacks with the impact of dash attacks...

Unlock mutations!

Alter how core mechanics behave, combine many mutations together after unlocking each one by winning...

Swift kinetic gameplay!

Everything surfs around and gets knocked around, be careful about worms bouncing back...

Tips

  • You are the 6-armed organism

  • You only get damaged if an enemy directly touches you

  • Enemy colors show their resistances to push/pull/lifesteal, not to damage

  • There is a small invulnerability window after dash and after being damaged

  • Big enemies can be shrunk!!

  • Hex (the red debuff on enemies) lets you Lifesteal!

  • Energy (the green meter) increases Health Regeneration, Dash and Blast Power!

  • Energy can go above normal limit with superpowers

  • Dash costs some Energy

  • Keep smashing enemies into Walls for extra damage! But watch out for the bounce-back

Controls

Controller support is planned. Current controls:

  • Aim Mouse: the player will move towards the mouse cursor

  • Left Mouse Button: Select

  • Right Mouse Button/[Space]: Dash

  • [Esc]: Back/Menu

Feedback

The game engine is built completely from 0, feel free to report any graphics/sound/networking/performance issues to the Discord or Steam Forums!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit fully updated
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12 Shader Model 6.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: On a very strong CPU can run without a GPU; detailed minimum Windows 10 version support: 1909 revision .1350, 2004 revision .789, 20H2 revision .789
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit fully updated
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12 Shader Model 6.8
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 48kHz stereo

short_description: Blast waves of worms back into the void! Choose eldritch superpowers each level for unique new mechanics! Your 6 jelly tendrils hold overpowered mutations! Dash and surf around in this fast-paced kinetic top-down action roguelite in an arcane petri dish and control dark rifts and curses...
